user.title: Step 1 of 3 · Connect Mijn Fluvius
user.description:
Start with Mijn Fluvius. You can add your electricity and gas meters before moving on to ENGIE.

- **Fluvius meters configured** — {meter_count}.
- **ENGIE Belgium** — {engie_status}.

menu_options.login: Sign in to a Mijn Fluvius account
menu_options.choose_account: Add a meter to an existing Fluvius account

choose_account.title: Choose a Mijn Fluvius account
choose_account.description: Select the account that can see this meter in Mijn Fluvius.

login.title: Step 1 of 3 · Sign in to Mijn Fluvius
login.description: Use a personal Mijn Fluvius account with email and password sign-in. After we verify the login, you can add the meters this account can access.

add_meter.title: Step 2 of 3 · Add a Fluvius meter
add_meter.description: In Mijn Fluvius, open **Verbruik → Mijn EAN-lijst** to find the EAN. Enter the physical meter’s serial number and select **Electricity** or **Gas**. You can add more meters after saving.

meter_reauth.title: Reconnect your Mijn Fluvius account
meter_reauth.description: Enter your current login details for the meter already configured.

meter_verified.title: Meter verified
meter_verified.description: Mijn Fluvius returned **{reading_count}** daily summaries for meter ending in **{serial_suffix}**. Save it to import history and choose what to do next.

more_meters.title: Step 2 of 3 · Finish Fluvius setup
more_meters.description: **{meter_count}** meter(s) saved with this Mijn Fluvius account. Add any remaining electricity or gas meters before proceeding.

menu_options.provider: Done with meters · Choose energy provider

provider.title: Step 3 of 3 · Choose your energy provider
provider.description: Choose the supplier whose contract rates you want to use. ENGIE Belgium is currently supported.

readiness.title: Step 3 of 3 · Connect ENGIE and check sources
readiness.description:
- **Imported kWh statistics** — {statistic_count} found. If the count is zero, wait for the meter's first import.
- **ENGIE Belgium** — {engie_status}, {rate_count} usable rates. [Open the built-in ENGIE setup](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/config_flow_start/?domain=engie_be) if needed.

Continue to recheck both sources and choose the statistic and rate.

pair.title: Select and test your sources
pair.description: Choose the Fluvius stream and its matching ENGIE contract rate for the same address. The wizard checks Recorder for the latest published day unless you choose a fixed offset.

data_description.label: Defaults to Energy. Change it if you want a distinct name for this estimate.
data_description.price_entity: Select the matching import, injection, or gas rate. Only available rates in EUR/kWh are listed.
data_description.days_ago: Leave blank to follow the most recent published day in the last 14 days.

review.title: Review your test result
review.description:
**{label}**

- {statistic_name} on {day}: **{usage} kWh**
- {rate_name}: **{rate} EUR/kWh**
- Estimated amount: **€{estimate}**

Check that both sources correspond before saving. After saving, open **Energy & Costs** in the sidebar.

error.no_rates: ENGIE is loaded but has no usable contract rates in EUR/kWh yet. Check its sensors and try again.
error.invalid_statistic: Select an available Fluvius statistic in kWh.
error.invalid_price: Select an ENGIE rate sensor with the EUR/kWh unit.
error.invalid_days: Enter a whole number from 1 to 14.
error.providers_not_ready: Complete the built-in ENGIE Belgium setup or repair its connection, then try again.
error.no_statistics: The first Fluvius import has not produced any historical kWh statistics yet. Wait for it to finish, then continue again.
error.recorder_unavailable: The Recorder check failed. Check Recorder in Home Assistant and try again.
error.no_readings_for_day: No usable readings are published for this day. Try a day further back or check the meter in Mijn Fluvius.
error.price_unavailable: This ENGIE rate is unavailable or has the wrong unit. Choose an active EUR/kWh rate or repair the ENGIE account.
error.invalid_ean: Enter the 18-digit EAN from Mijn Fluvius.
error.invalid_serial: Enter the meter serial number using letters, digits, or hyphens.
error.wrong_meter: Use the same EAN, serial number, and meter type as the existing entry.
error.fluvius_auth: Mijn Fluvius rejected the sign-in. Try your personal portal email and password.
error.fluvius_login_connection: Couldn't verify the Mijn Fluvius login. Try again once the portal is reachable.
error.saved_fluvius_auth: Mijn Fluvius rejected the saved login. Update the account on its existing meter entry or start a new connection.
error.account_removed: That Fluvius account is no longer available. Choose another account.
error.fluvius_connection: Couldn't check this meter. Verify the EAN and serial number in Mijn Fluvius and try again.
error.fluvius_empty: The portal returned no recent daily summaries. Check whether your account can see this meter's consumption.

abort.already_configured: This meter or energy estimate is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The Mijn Fluvius account was reconnected.
